# Indian Business Directory Canada

> > A comprehensive business directory connecting Indian entrepreneurs and service providers across Canada with local community members.

Indian Business Directory Canada is a classified listings platform serving the Indian diaspora in Canada, featuring businesses across multiple service categories including accommodation, automotive, construction, financial services, and lifestyle services. The directory helps Indian-Canadian entrepreneurs reach their community while providing convenient access to trusted local services.
